summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, plus the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias), exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with the binary 2D and empty class cases. Nothing was run and nothing was committed. The cross-sample TP and D terms use an equivalent vectorized form (alpha times a per-voxel sum over samples) rather than the spec's batch-by-batch loop. The one line over 120 columns (dice.py:36) predates this change.
